name: Multiply rule
summary: Two arity-1 H-boxes with labels a and b merged by a Z-spider become one H-box with label ab.
description:
An arity-1 H-box with label $a$ is the (unnormalised) state $|0\rangle + a|1\rangle$. The Z-spider with two inputs and one output multiplies such states entrywise, so two of them merge into the state $|0\rangle + ab\,|1\rangle$, an H-box with label $ab$.

When $a = e^{i\alpha}$ and $b = e^{i\beta}$ this is just phase addition under [spider fusion](../spider-fusion/). See the [generalised multiply rule](../zh-multiply-generalised/) for H-boxes of higher arity.
